shared_years <- intersect(
  names(edu_clean)[grepl("^[0-9]{4}$", names(edu_clean))],
  names(internet)[grepl("^[0-9]{4}$", names(internet))]
)

edu_long <- edu_clean |>
  select(iso3 = geo, all_of(shared_years)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(shared_years),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "education_index"
  ) |>
  mutate(iso3 = toupper(iso3), year = as.integer(year)) |>
  select(iso3, year, education_index)

internet_long <- internet |>
  select(iso3 = geo, all_of(shared_years)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(shared_years),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "internet_users"
  ) |>
  mutate(iso3 = toupper(iso3), year = as.integer(year)) |>
  select(iso3, year, internet_users)

joined_data <- map |>
  mutate(
    iso3 = ISO3166.1.Alpha.3,
    join_key = 1L
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    tibble(year = as.integer(shared_years), join_key = 1L),
    by = "join_key",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  select(-join_key) |>
  left_join(edu_long, by = c("iso3", "year")) |>
  left_join(internet_long, by = c("iso3", "year"))
